subject: Order Form — reference rights & confidentiality: audit trail and logo use
messages:
From: Jane Summers <jane.summers@orionlabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Timothy Lowe <t.lowe@orionlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redlines: MSA (confidentiality & reference language)

Hi Karthik / Naomi,

Thanks for the draft MSA and order form — attached are our redlines focused on confidentiality and reference rights. Two asks from legal:

1) Narrow the reference clause so Orion is only referenced in press collateral with prior written approval (we expect an approval log).
2) Add an audit trail requirement: any press/quote approval must have an evidentiary record (DocuSign acceptance, dated email from our comms lead, or asset approval screenshot).

We also proposed a short embargo window around joint announcements (7 business days) and flagged logo usage: we need a versioned logo asset and restrictions on co-branding lockups.

Attaching: Orion_MSA_redlines_20270513.docx and OrderForm_Orion_20270513.pdf. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept the proposed audit-evidence language or suggest a lightweight alternative?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement wants to close this week if possible.

Best,
Jane Summers
Sr. Counsel, Orion Labs
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Summers <jane.summers@orionlabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redlines: MSA (confidentiality & reference language)

Jane — thanks for the redlines and the clear asks.

Quick notes from the commercial side: we are fine with prior written approval for press quotes and require an approval log for our own recordkeeping. The audit trail requirement is reasonable but we want to avoid heavy operational friction for mutual customers.

Naomi / Grace — looping you in to advise on the legal wording and the minimal evidence mechanism the legal team is comfortable accepting (DocuSign sign-off vs. a confirmation email). Also can Legal confirm whether the proposed 7-business-day embargo is acceptable or if 10 is standard for the MSA?

Action items I propose:
- Legal to propose a single short paragraph that satisfies Orion's ask while allowing Redwood to accept screenshots / signed approval as evidence.
- Commercial to accept logo constraints as long as asset delivery is automated from a shared Drive link.

Monica — can you prep the shared drive folder link we can provide to Orion for logo assets and track versions?

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Orion redlines — proposal for minimal audit-evidence language

Naomi / Grace — forwarding Orion's redlines (attached) and my note to them.

My suggested compromise paragraph for review:

"Subject to prior written approval by Customer, Redwood may reference Customer as a customer in marketing materials and case studies. Approval may be provided in writing by email from an authorized Customer contact, by a DocuSign confirmation, or by upload to the Customer-approved asset repository. Redwood will retain the approval record for audit purposes."

Two related questions:
- Do we need to explicitly list what constitutes an "authorized Customer contact" or is naming job titles (e.g., Legal, Head of Comms) enough?
- For embargo window, commercial prefers 7 business days; if legal recommends 10, call that out and we will push back slightly on length.

Thanks — please mark up the paragraph and return edits.

-Karthik
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Orion redlines — proposal for minimal audit-evidence language

Karthik / Grace — thanks for the suggested language. Small edits inline below (we preserve compactness but remove ambiguity):

Revised paragraph (Legal suggested):

"Subject to Customer's prior written approval, Redwood may reference Customer as a customer in marketing materials and case studies. 'Prior written approval' means (a) an email from a named Customer representative with title and organization, (b) a DocuSign or similar electronic signature confirmation, or (c) an approval uploaded to the mutually-agreed asset repository. Redwood will retain a copy of the approval, including metadata (approver name, date, and the approved asset), for audit purposes for the term of the MSA."

Notes:
- We recommend capturing the approver's name and job title in the email to avoid downstream disputes.
- For "authorized Customer contact" let's keep it open but ask Orion to provide a primary approver list (Name + Title + email) as part of SOW onboarding — this avoids contract bloat.
- Embargo window: 10 business days is standard in our playbook for coordinated announcements; if Commercial wants 7, we can accept 7 as long as it's agreed in the order form.
- Logo assets: we'll accept a versioned asset repository. Monica, please create a folder and set view/edit permissions; attach the link to the order form.

I've attached an "AuditEvidence_Template.docx" that records the minimal fields we should capture for each approval (approver, title, date, asset link, method).

If everyone agrees, Karthik can present this to Orion and confirm the approver list.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Karthik / Naomi — thanks for the fast turnaround and the revised paragraph. Orion is comfortable with Naomi's language. A couple of final items:

- We'll provide a short approver list (Name / Title / email) by EOD Monday.
- 7 business days embargo is acceptable to our comms lead — we will note that in the order form as a mutual option.
- Logo asset: we'll upload a versioned primary/secondary logo pack to the shared folder once you send the Drive link.

Please send the small MSA addendum (the single paragraph Naomi proposed) and the order-form note about embargo + asset repo link, and we'll route to DocuSign.

Thanks — looking forward to closing.

Best,
Jane Summers
Sr. Counsel, Orion Labs
